body:
## Purpose

Make the Factory consume composed agent capability through stable refs instead of Factory-local agent configuration. The composition already exists on both sides; the intake seam does not.

## Relation

- Central #108 / #112 / #117 — authored AgentProfile source, canonical Actions, RoutineRef assignments
- closed EpiLogos/O-I #169 — W12 witness: Central AgentProfile source + independent AIKit effective-state reading composed in the Personal application
- closed #176 — persistent Agent/AgentSet ownership of developmental Journeys
- ai-kit `compose` — Central profile + Actuation instantiation receipt → actor bootstrap (already live surface)

## Work

1. Define the intake contract: a Factory Commission/Run accepts an agent capability description as typed stable refs — authored Central AgentProfile ref + AIKit-resolved effective Profile/SkillSet generation ref — never a copied config blob.
2. Extend the W12 witness pattern (journey-routine-handoff) to prove the three-way relation: authored source (Central) → effective composition (AIKit) → developmental use (Factory Run), each side independently readable.
3. Conformance lane: exact-revision test binding this repo's intake to the pinned Central/ai-kit revisions in O:I `suite/mainline.json`.
4. Failure honesty: unresolved/retired/withheld SkillSet members surface as explicit intake facts (the K2 retirement-aware law), never silently dropped.

## Acceptance

- a Run can be commissioned whose agent capability comes entirely from stable refs;
- the same refs resolve to the same authored+effective evidence on all three sides;
- retirement/withholding is visible at intake;
- conformance lane green against pinned mains;
- no Factory-local agent configuration format remains as a parallel truth.
title: [OI-PROFILE-INTAKE] Receive composed Agent profiles with attached SkillSets through stable refs
